sentences.en: In Algiers, the El Harrach River became an open sewer.
sentences.zh: 在阿尔及尔，埃尔哈拉奇河变成了一个开放的下水道。

sentences.en: I heard that there were alligators in the sewers.
sentences.zh: 我听说下水道里有鳄鱼。

sentences.en: The El Harrach River functions like an open sewer.
sentences.zh: 埃尔哈拉奇河的功能就像一个开放的下水道。

senses.zh: 为…铺设污水管道；用下水道排除…的污水
